source_notes: Reflux conditions differ by source location: Abstract gives 80–100°C and 4–6 h; Experimental says 70–100°C for 6 h; Figure 1 caption and Conclusion specify 100°C for 4 h. Preserve these locators and do not harmonize silently.
Exact precursor masses, liquid volumes, NH4OH dose, pH, actual measured-sample starting concentration and oven-drying settings are absent.
TEM reports about 30 nm mean particle size; XRD Scherrer estimate is 40 nm. These method-specific results are retained in parallel.
Introductory structure sentence prints space group P42/mmm. This is transcribed as source wording only and is not independently validated or assigned to the experimental specimen.
No measured atomic coordinates or CIF are supplied.
The paper gives no formula for the fresh tin hydroxide precipitate in the calcination comparator; formula intentionally left unspecified.
Comparator precursor and hydrothermal specimen are not linked by a sample identifier; no exact parent-preparation linkage is asserted.
